name: Creek Minnow
note: Small, fast, and convinced the whole creek is about to be eaten. Usually right.

name: Sunny Perch
note: Bit your hook out of pure curiosity. Perch have never once learned from it.

name: Brook Trout
note: Rufus calls these 'proper fish'. It's the only nice thing he's said about the creek in twenty years.

name: Crayfish
note: Not technically a fish. Don't tell him. He's very proud.

name: Dawn Char
note: Only bites while the mist is still on the water. Early risers and char: the last honest creatures.

name: Glimmer Dace
note: Catches the sunset on its scales and won't give it back. Tobias used to say they were pockets of evening.

name: Moonbass
note: Comes up to look at the moon. Thinks the moon is a very large moonbass. I've never corrected him.

name: Night Eel
note: Polite, in its way. Slippery, in every other way.

name: Old Whiskers
note: Older than me. Older than the mill. I put him back every time and he comes back looking smug about it.

name: Rainbow Pike
note: Every colour the creek has, all on one fish. Hazel wants to name a crop after it. Tell her no.

name: Silver Ghost
note: Forty years I've heard about this fish and never seen one. And you just pulled it out like a radish.

name: Golden Carp
note: Tobias swore he saw one in 1979, the same summer as his golden moth. Everyone laughed. Go and tell him. Run.
